Analysis Formatting

tests.test_analysis_format.test_analysis_page_contains_answer_labels()

Verify that the analysis page renders answer labels.

The test creates the Flask application in testing mode, requests the /analysis endpoint, and verifies that the response succeeds and contains the Answer: label.

Raises:

AssertionError – If the analysis endpoint does not return HTTP 200 or the response does not contain an answer label.

tests.test_analysis_format.test_orm_queries_main(monkeypatch)

Verify that the ORM query entry point invokes the expected questions.

The test replaces the database session and selected question functions with fakes, then verifies that src.orm_queries.main() invokes the expected question functions in the required order.

Parameters:

monkeypatch (_pytest.monkeypatch.MonkeyPatch) – Pytest fixture used to replace the ORM session and question functions during the test.

Raises:

AssertionError – If the expected ORM question functions are not invoked or are invoked in the wrong order.

tests.test_analysis_format.test_orm_questions_print_branches(question, expected, capsys)

Verify that each ORM analysis question prints its answer label.

Each parameterized case invokes one of the ORM question functions with a fake database session. The test verifies that the function writes the expected question label to standard output.

Parameters:

  • question (callable) – ORM question function being tested.

  • expected (str) – Expected question label printed by the function.

  • capsys (_pytest.capture.CaptureFixture) – Pytest fixture used to capture standard output.

Raises:

AssertionError – If the expected question label is not present in the captured output.

tests.test_analysis_format.test_percentages_have_two_decimal_places()

Verify that percentages on the analysis page use two decimal places.

The test extracts percentage values from the rendered /analysis page and verifies that every percentage matches the format N.NN%.

Raises:

AssertionError – If the analysis endpoint fails, no percentage values are rendered, or any percentage does not contain exactly two decimal places.
